newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Sberbank may tap foreign markets in autumn.
newsitem.headline: Russian Sberbank may tap foreign markets in autumn.

text.p: Russia's biggest bank, Sberbank, may tap international markets by this autumn, its President Andrei Kazmin said on Friday.

"By autumn some results (of entering the international market) will be known," Kazmin told a news conference. "We did not push forward with the decision intentionally before an international audit is done."
It was not clear whether Kazmin meant Eurobonds, credits or American Depositary Receipt share look-alikes.
The completed audit to international accounting standards was done by Price Waterhouse.
Sberbank is Russia's biggest operator on the government securities market and is the biggest holder of individual deposits.
On the Russian Trading System Sberbank closed at $142.5 on Friday after $138.7 at Thursday's close.
